title: PvP Duel: Draft & Fight Your Friends
description:
[h1]Slay your friends, not just the Spire.[/h1]
Up to four players. Decks built on the spot. One survives.

[b]PvP Duel[/b] adds a [b]Duel[/b] button to the main menu and turns the game's co-op into a fight between you and your friends: a 1v1 duel, or a [b]free-for-all of up to 4 players[/b].

[h2]⚔ Draft your weapon[/h2]
Before the first blow, every player builds their deck live:
[list]
[*][b]10 booster packs[/b] of 5 random cards from your character's pool: keep one card from each pack, like a Magic draft. Commons, uncommons, rares: build the combo from what you open.
[*][b]5 relics[/b], one out of three each round. Every pick shapes your plan.
[/list]
Every draft is different: read your packs, build your deck, then straight into battle.

[h2]🔥 Then fight[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your opponents stand across the arena as [b]their own characters[/b], with their real HP, block and powers. Attack whoever you want.
[*][b]Turns rotate[/b]: the host strikes first, then each player in lobby order. Your block holds through everyone else's turn.
[*]Everything hits for real: Vulnerable, Weak, poison, Thorns, potions. AoE hits [b]every[/b] opponent.
[*]Die and you're out (you can watch the rest). Last one standing gets [b]Victory![/b], everyone else gets their place. Rage-quit? That's a forfeit.
[*]Want revenge? Hit [b]Rematch[/b] on the end screen to pick again, or [b]Same Character[/b] to keep yours and go straight to a new draft.
[/list]

[h2]🌐 How to play[/h2]
[list]
[*]Every player subscribes, start the game and accept the mods popup.
[*][b]Quick Match[/b] (beta test, may not work properly): [b]Duel → Quick Match[/b] finds a random 1v1 opponent over Steam.
[*][b]Play with friends[/b]: [b]Duel → Host[/b] gives you a 5-letter room code (copied for you). Friends (up to 3) type it and click [b]Join[/b]. Goes through Steam: no IP, no Hamachi, no ports.
[*][b]By IP[/b] (LAN, Hamachi, ZeroTier): [b]Host by IP[/b], friends type your IP and [b]Join[/b]. The host needs [b]UDP port 33771[/b] open.
[*]Pick characters, draft, fight!
[/list]
Everyone needs the same game version and the same mod list.

Duel runs are not saved and don't count for stats or unlocks.
Built on the game's own co-op connection and turn sync.
changeNote: 1.6.1: Fixed the game crashing at startup (right before the main menu) when launched from Steam with mods. The cause was the game's crash reporter being closed too early on modded launches; the mod now keeps it open (all reports are still discarded).
